lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 4 to 5 faint, low-contrast vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso with irregular spacing.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Visible lines are abbreviated or dashed, terminating before reaching the dorsal crest or the ventral hair fringe.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns display a lyrate trajectory, flaring laterally from the base before curving medially and dorsally toward the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the apical tips is approximately 2.5 times the width of the horn bases at the skull.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The distal 12-15% of the horn length exhibits high-contrast ivory-colored tipping relative to the dark primary horn body.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal crest; white chevron marking between the eyes; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek; long dark hair fringe on the neck and underbelly.
